summary: Iter 39 P1 full sweep — Backend: 37 PASS / 1 SKIP / 0 FAIL across the 5 new iter39 test files (admin org integrations, admin entitlement inspection, api v1 alias, entitlement service layer, stripe payments). All invariants verified: (a) ERP360 GET/PATCH round-trip with merge updates, empty-string clears, billing_mode validation (erp360/native_stripe accepted, 'stripe' 400s), learner 403; (b) admin entitlements listing with paid-only default, include_free widens, per-course endpoint returns remediation for entitled=False, cross-tenant lookup returns 410, learner 403, missing course 404; (c) Stripe checkout session creation returns real https://checkout.stripe.com/... URL + cs_test_ session_id, PaymentTransaction row persisted at status='initiated' with amount_cents pulled from Course.price_cents (not client), free course refuses with 400, unknown course 404, cross-user status lookup 404, status-before-payment shows entitled=false/payment_status=unpaid; (d) /api/v1/* alias mirrors every /api/* route with X-API-Version=v1 header (unversioned omits it), shares cache buckets, preserves query/body/path params, 404s on bogus paths; (e) entitlement service: free courses skip check, paid without entitlement raises 402, active Subscription grants access (reason='subscription'), same-org ADMIN/INSTRUCTOR gets comp access (reason='comp_role'), cross-tenant admin gets NO access (reason='none') — closes cross-tenant leak; POST /api/courses/{id}/enroll on paid course returns 402 with 'entitlement' in the detail message. Frontend E2E on preview URL as admin: ERP360 page /integrations/erp360 renders all 6 testids (connected/sso toggles, org_slug input, billing_mode select, save btn, raw json details); toggled sso_enabled false→true, saved, saw 'ERP360 integration updated' toast, reloaded and confirmed persistence (fresh GET returned sso_enabled=true), restored to false. Entitlements page /entitlements: entered user_id=2 (learner), 54 paid-only rows rendered; toggled 'Include free' → 65 rows; reason chips 'Free'/'Subscription'/'No access' correctly rendered per row. Learner E2E: logged in, opened paid course /catalog/285 (US$49), clicked cta-enroll ('Get access') → browser redirected to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... showing the real hosted Sandbox checkout page for US$49.00; a PaymentTransaction row (id=17, status='initiated', amount_cents=4900, user_id=2, currency='usd') was written before the redirect. BillingSuccessPage polling: hit /billing/success?session_id=<real_unpaid_session>, watched all 8 polling attempts increment ('Attempt N of 8'), then final state = 'Waiting for confirmation' as spec'd. Admin.must_change_password restored to True after run.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/admin_organizations.py — GET/PATCH scoped by dependency (ADMIN of the same org, or SUPER_ADMIN); merge-update semantics correctly implemented (empty string CLEARS via nullify, unspecified fields preserved). billing_mode whitelist ('erp360','native_stripe') returns 400 on unknown value with the field name in detail — good defense against client-side dropdown drift. Every PATCH emits ORG_ERP360_INTEGRATION_UPDATED audit row + invalidates feature-flags cache (verified via test).

routers/admin_entitlements.py — Cross-tenant lookup correctly returns 410 GONE (not 404) so the caller can't fingerprint whether the user exists in another org. include_free query param cleanly widens the SQL filter without a second endpoint. Per-course response includes 'remediation' human-string that references '/api/billing/subscribe' — matches the Entitlements Inspector chip UX.

routers/stripe_payments.py — Amount always taken from Course.price_cents (client 'origin_url' passthrough is only for success_url templating). PaymentTransaction row is committed BEFORE the Stripe URL is returned (proven by test_transaction_row_written_before_redirect). Status endpoint scoped to owning user (cross-user returns 404, verified). Free courses correctly 400 with 'free' in message.

services/entitlement_service.py — Three-source resolution (free / comp_role / subscription) with cross-tenant guard on comp_role; require_course_entitlement raises 402 (not 403) which is the correct semantic for 'payment required'. reason() vocabulary is enum-like ('subscription'|'comp_role'|'none'|'free') and matches both admin inspector chips and test assertions.

core/api_versioning.py — ApiV1AliasMiddleware rewrites /api/v1/* → /api/* and stamps X-API-Version=v1 on the way out. Cache buckets are shared (verified via checked_at equality on erp360/sync/status), which is the correct behaviour for identical semantics.

frontend/Erp360IntegrationsPage.tsx — onSuccess snapshot into local draft is a react-query v5 anti-pattern (onSuccess removed from useQuery in v5) — the current code uses `as any` cast to bypass TS. It works because the draft falls through to `data || null` in the render selector. Recommend migrating to a useEffect[data] draft-initialiser in a future iteration; not a blocker.

frontend/BillingSuccessPage.tsx — 8-attempt × 2s poll (16s wall clock) then 'Waiting for confirmation' is friendly UX; auto-enroll on paid state uses enrolledRef guard against re-renders and idempotent server-side POST; correctly handles missing session_id (error state).
